# DR-9105: Sarah Chen's 15% NS-500 discount for Acme Industrial Supply Co. (2026-09-23)

**Decision: REVIEW_REQUIRED.** It cannot be approved as submitted, because the contract terms it cites belong to a different customer.

**1. The customer is not Acme Manufacturing.**
- DR-9105 is recorded against **CRM-2091, Acme Industrial Supply Co.** It is in Akron, OH, with DUNS 09-552-1187 and ERP customer C-1044. It is a Standard-tier account owned by Zachary Brown.
- The justification cites the "Acme Master Supply Agreement". That agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its Schedule B exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15, up to 15% on NS-500, valid 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31) are with **Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing**. That is CRM-2048 / C-1001, in Milwaukee, DUNS 04-812-7730.
- Northstar's own Schedule C states that Acme Industrial Supply Co. is a different company.
- The SOP says an exception is scoped to what it names, and special terms do not transfer to another customer.
- No document gives Acme Industrial Supply any special NS-500 pricing. A discount on contract grounds therefore needs commercial review.

**2. The request may have been logged against the wrong account.**
- Sarah's 2026-09-23 email to Michael Torres describes the Acme Manufacturing third-plant deal and says she logged it as **DR-9001**.
- DR-9001 exists on CRM-2048 with identical figures.
- DR-9105 looks like a duplicate entered on the wrong account. Sarah also does not own CRM-2091.
- I have decided only on DR-9105 as recorded, not on DR-9001.

**3. Authority (Pricing Policy 2026, in force on 2026-09-23).**
- An Enterprise Account Executive may approve discounts up to 10%.
- Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need the **Commercial Policy Lead, Dana Okafor**.
- Sarah could not approve 15% herself even if eligibility were established. Her 2025 approval at 15% (DR-8104) relied on the 2025 policy, which has been replaced.
- The contract does not change internal authority (MSA §3.3).

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9105", "customer": "Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091 / ERP C-1044)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 15.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered", "maximum_discount": null,
                             "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 / EXC-ACME-NS500-15 cover Acme Mfg. Holdings (CRM-2048, C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730) only; no agreement or exception exists for Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091, DUNS 09-552-1187); special terms do not transfer"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9105, DR-9001, DR-8104)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv", "structured/customers.csv", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md", "documents/acme_support_schedule_c.md", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md", "documents/email_sarah_to_michael.md"],
  "missing_evidence": ["Any signed agreement or pricing exception granting Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091) special NS-500 pricing"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Commercial review of whether any special NS-500 pricing applies to Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091); the Acme Manufacturing MSA/exception cannot be relied on for this customer", "who": "Dana Okafor (Commercial Policy Lead)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Confirm with the requestor whether DR-9105 was logged against the wrong account and duplicates DR-9001 (Acme Manufacturing, CRM-2048); if so, withdraw DR-9105 and decide DR-9001 separately", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "CRM-2091 is owned by Zachary Brown, not the requestor; account owner should confirm the opportunity", "who": "Zachary Brown", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
